email.subject1: a co-sell play for Mechanical Orchard
email.body1:
Andy, saw Mechanical Orchard launched Imogen and signed its first partnership with Thoughtworks.

Standing up a partner motion usually means more co-sell accounts than the team can cover by hand, and partner-sourced pipeline stalls when nobody works the ecosystem at scale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across a partner's account base, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Mechanical Orchard's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Andy, quick follow-up on the partner side.

Early partner motions usually struggle to cover the joint account base, so partner-sourced pipeline shows up late and thin while reps stay heads-down on direct deals. The fix is consistent, personalized outreach into the ecosystem that runs without pulling your team off their own quota or asking partners to do the legwork.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body3:
Andy, last bit of proof for Mechanical Orchard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your partner-sourced reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a partner program is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I'll tailor it to Mechanical Orchard either way.
